title: XV: Hester and Pearl

teacherSummary.text: Hester admits to herself that she hates Chillingworth. Pearl makes a green letter A of eelgrass on her own breast and asks what the scarlet letter means and why the minister keeps his hand over his heart. Hester, for the first time, lies to her.
